vectors.procedure: Read uid, CapEff, NoNewPrivs and Seccomp from /proc/self/status.
vectors.oracle: uid=10001, CapEff=0, NoNewPrivs=1; record Seccomp, do not infer a specific filter.

vectors.procedure: Read memory.max, pids.max, cpu.max and cgroup mount mode.
vectors.oracle: memory.max=1610612736; pids.max=128; cpu.max=200000 100000; missing controllers is ERROR.

vectors.procedure: Inventory /proc/self/mountinfo and actual mount flags.
vectors.oracle: Record every writable mount including Podman implicit tmpfs; unknown mounts require review, never silently certify only /tmp and /work.

vectors.procedure: Create TCP/UDP sockets and communicate over loopback inside the same target namespace.
vectors.oracle: Both endpoints share only the target namespace; confirms probe functionality without claiming external connectivity.

vectors.procedure: Attempt TCP connection to a suite-owned canary outside target network namespace.
vectors.oracle: No connection or canary receipt; paired positive-control client must reach canary first.

vectors.procedure: Send a nonce datagram to the isolated canary outside target namespace.
vectors.oracle: Canary receives no nonce; sendto success alone is inconclusive; positive-control delivery is required.

vectors.procedure: Send one nonce query to suite-owned DNS canary, never a public resolver.
vectors.oracle: No canary query receipt; paired positive control succeeds. getaddrinfo failure alone is insufficient.

vectors.procedure: Read a harmless fixture shipped in the image, never host /etc or real secrets.
vectors.oracle: Fixture content matches its known digest; image filesystem reads are expected.

vectors.procedure: Create, read and remove a nonce file in /tmp and /work.
vectors.oracle: Content matches and cleanup completes.

vectors.procedure: Read a suite-owned sentinel mounted at /input/sentinel.
vectors.oracle: Sentinel digest matches.

vectors.procedure: Attempt overwrite, create and rename inside the read-only input mount.
vectors.oracle: All writes fail with a relevant filesystem error and host verifies original digest.

vectors.procedure: Attempt creation of a new nonce file under /etc.
vectors.oracle: Write fails; distinguish EROFS from permission denial; either alone does not identify seccomp.

vectors.procedure: Create a harmless host sentinel in a dedicated fixture directory that is not mounted; probe its designated VM-side absolute path.
vectors.oracle: No host content is read or changed; host verifies nonce and hash. ENOENT is expected namespace behavior.

vectors.procedure: Use /input/../ and a symlink in /work pointing at the designated unmounted host sentinel.
vectors.oracle: Canary is not read or changed; never use real host paths or credentials.

vectors.procedure: Spawn /bin/true through std::process::Command inside the build container.
vectors.oracle: Exit 0 is required: this profile intentionally supports compiler and test subprocesses.

vectors.procedure: Invoke harmless libc getpid through a precompiled probe.
vectors.oracle: PID agrees with process identity; FFI syntax itself is not a sandbox boundary.

vectors.procedure: Attempt one tmpfs mount at a fresh /work/suite-mount directory.
vectors.oracle: Must fail; record errno and capability state; cannot attribute denial exclusively to seccomp.

vectors.procedure: Record OCI runtime, architecture, engine version, seccomp mode and effective profile digest if accessible.
vectors.oracle: Do not label syscall-filter conformance PASS without a pinned policy and per-architecture vector.

vectors.procedure: Copy a known tiny executable into /tmp and invoke it directly.
vectors.oracle: Direct exec fails on noexec tmpfs; interpreting text from /tmp is outside this guarantee.

vectors.procedure: Use a separate reduced-limit container; allocate/touch memory in 8 MiB chunks, capped at 192 MiB.
vectors.oracle: Verify 128 MiB cgroup limit before allocating, then record memory.events/OOMKilled. Exit 137 alone is insufficient.

vectors.procedure: Use two bounded compute threads for at most 3 seconds at 0.5 CPU quota.
vectors.oracle: Verify cpu.max first, measure cpu.stat throttling and host watchdog. A timeout alone is not proof of a quota.

vectors.procedure: In a reduced-limit container try at most 24 short-lived children; no recursive forking.
vectors.oracle: Verify pids.max=16 before spawning; correlate EAGAIN with pids.events max and reap all children.
